text: Hi there, I live in Long Island New York, and I am looking to use local inputs as my fertilizer fertilizer and compost, and both a slow composting process using earth worms, red wigglers in particular, along with a thermal, hot compost. I grow a variety of crops. I grow cannabis, lots of brassicas, lettuce, beans, tomatoes. I would like to use locally found resources, such as Woodchips, Horse Manure, and other local plants.
